d=json.load(sys.stdin)
t=d.get('tool_input',{})
s=t.get('content') or t.get('new_string') or ''
bt=chr(96);dq=chr(34)
bad=[]
for L in s.splitlines():
 x=re.sub(bt+'[^'+bt+']*'+bt,'',L)
 x=re.sub(dq+'[^'+dq+']*'+dq,'',x)
 low=L.lower()
 if re.search(r'§ ?8|section 8',x.lower()) and 'raid-composition-guide' not in low and 'target spec ranges' not in low:
  bad.append(L.strip())
if bad:
 sys.stderr.write('Blocked: bare section-8 reference used as the table name. Use the canonical name target spec ranges (CLAUDE.md Communication conventions); it is allowed only as a cross-reference naming reference/raid-composition-guide.md, or as a backtick/quote-wrapped mention. Offending: '+' | '.join(bad))
 sys.exit(2)
sys.exit(0)"
